id: title:Gilbert09:stop reporting queue schema lag as a bug

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a helper function and tests to distinguish database schema migration errors from other failures in warehouse ingestion, potentially reducing false-positive error reporting or unnecessary restarts.
review.reason: Adds a helper function `_is_schema_lag_error` and recovery-loop integration tests to distinguish database schema migration errors from other failures, potentially reducing false-positive error reporting or unnecessary restarts.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit of distinguishing these errors is not independently verified; the score relies on the implementation and test presence rather than observed production outcomes.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No score is assigned; tier assignment requires a review, not a classification.

observations.behavior: Adds a helper function _is_schema_lag_error that checks for psycopg.errors.UndefinedColumn or psycopg.errors.UndefinedTable, and its use in startup and recovery sweep exception handling.
observations.posthog_connection: This could help distinguish transient schema-migration race conditions from other failures in warehouse ingestion, potentially reducing false-positive error reporting or unnecessary restarts.

observations.behavior: Adds a dedicated test class and assertions for the schema-lag classification, including a recovery-loop integration test.
observations.code_quote: assert _is_schema_lag_error(psycopg.errors.UndefinedColumn("column b.destination_ids does not exist")) is True
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection for the schema-lag classification and recovery behavior.
